Class GameController

java.lang.Object
game.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
The main controller class for the Inverse Monopoly game.

This class handles the core game loop, player turns, board interactions, and game state management including win/loss conditions (Bankruptcy).

  • Method Details

    • setupGame

      public void setupGame()
      Displays the initial game setup information and lists the participating players.

    • startGameLoop

      public void startGameLoop()
      Starts the main game loop.

      The loop continues until the win condition is met (only one player remains with money, or a player goes bankrupt depending on the game rules).

    • getNextPlayer

      public Player getNextPlayer()
      Retrieves the next valid player in the turn rotation.
      Returns:
      The next Player object, or null if no players are available.

    • getCurrentPlayer

      public Player getCurrentPlayer()
      Gets the player whose turn it currently is. Used primarily by the GUI to update the display.
      Returns:
      The current Player.

    • moveToNextPlayer

      public void moveToNextPlayer()
      Advances the game to the next player's turn manually.

    • handleBankruptcy

      public void handleBankruptcy(Player player)
      Handles the bankruptcy process for a player.

      This method announces the winner/loser, returns the player's properties to the board, resets property statuses (removes landmarks), and removes the player from the game.

      Parameters:
      player - The player who has gone bankrupt.

    • handleSkipTurn

      public void handleSkipTurn(Player player)
      Decrements the skip turn counter for a player and notifies them.
      Parameters:
      player - The player skipping the turn.

    • handleJailTurn

      public boolean handleJailTurn(Player player)
      Manages the turn logic when a player is in Jail. Offers the player a choice to pay to get out.
      Parameters:
      player - The player in jail.
      Returns:
      true if the player paid and should take a normal turn immediately; false otherwise.

    • takeNormalTurn

      public void takeNormalTurn(Player player)
      Executes a normal turn for a player: rolling dice, moving, and interacting with the landed square.
      Parameters:
      player - The current player.

    • handleLandedSquareAction

      public void handleLandedSquareAction(Player player)
      Identifies the type of square the player landed on and triggers the appropriate action. Supports Card squares, Property squares, Airplane squares, and standard squares. * [UPDATED] Added support for Rentable interface.
      Parameters:
      player - The player who just moved.

    • handleRentableSquare

      public void handleRentableSquare(Player player, Square square)
      Handles generic Rentable squares (e.g. IslandSquare). Since Rentable interface only has calculateRent(), we might need to cast to specific types to handle ownership/buying if the interface doesn't support it.

    • handlePropertySquare

      public void handlePropertySquare(Player player, Property property)
      Handles interactions with a Property square (Rent, Buyout, Upgrade, Purchase).
      Parameters:
      player - The player landing on the property.
      property - The property square.

    • handleAirplaneSquare

      public void handleAirplaneSquare(Player player)
      Handles the user interface logic for selecting a destination when landing on an Airplane square.
      Parameters:
      player - The player traveling by airplane.

    • handleAirplaneAction

      public void handleAirplaneAction(Player player, int targetPosition)
      Executes the logic for moving a player via Airplane to a target position. Calculates the steps required (considering board wrap-around) and moves the player.
      Parameters:
      player - The player moving.
      targetPosition - The index of the destination square (0-19).
